svg.aria-label: CabalMesh compute model — which device runs which workload
svg.text: COMPUTE MODEL · WHERE EACH WORKLOAD RUNS
One deal, three machines. The phone you have, the node on your desk, the locker at your door.
App shell, identity keys, intent UI, transaction
Whatever the user already owns. Tauri 2 over one
Battery-bound. Both boxes are optional to it: the
app works with neither of them present.
Three jobs in one enclosure: the mesh radio that
carries other people's traffic, the local model that
reads your sentence, and the prover.
8-core 2.4 GHz + ~20 TOPS NPU, 16 GB LPDDR5, 256 GB
NVMe. BLE 5.3 + Wi-Fi 6, LoRa bay. Fanless.
8B model at 4-bit, ~15 tok/s. 12 W idle, 25 W
proving. 100-300 kbit/s shared across a room.
the prompt, the witness, the plaintext it never had
Watches one deal. Verifies the on-chain release,
drives the bolt, and weighs what is inside — so the
app can say the item went in, not what it is.
Secure element + Cortex-M33 with TrustZone, BLE 5.3,
motorised bolt, load cell in the floor.
4 x D cells, about 12 months idle. The bolt draws
for 1.5 s a cycle, the radio in bursts.
the latch key — it answers only to a settled deal
— left to right, each step names the machine that runs it
THREE OF THE SIX, INSIDE ONE BOX
STATUS The phone column is what ships today — see docs/product-status.md. Both boxes are Phase-2 concepts: no silicon selected, no board, no enclosure.
GROUNDING Mesh figures from docs/ble-mesh-design.md · local-model path from OLLAMA_INTEGRATION.md · escrow from contracts/contracts/Marketplace.sol · proving is Phase 4, no circuit in the repo
